# Aadesh Gurav

> Backend engineer building production systems for the real world — WhatsApp automation, offline-first canteen and clinic software, and databases written from scratch. Based in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra, India (Konkan coast), available remote.

Aadesh works mostly in Python (FastAPI, Django) and NestJS, with Rust for systems-level curiosity projects. Recent production work includes a multi-tenant WhatsApp automation gateway, a school canteen management system running off a phone hotspot, and a personal FastAPI boilerplate used as the foundation for client work.

This site ([aadeshgurav.online](https://aadeshgurav.online/)) is a personal portfolio with 8 selectable visual themes (Terminal, Glassmorphism Night, Apple Liquid Glass, Flat Minimal, Cyberpunk, Swiss Editorial, Neubrutalist, Bento Dashboard) — the content is identical across themes, only the presentation differs.

## Projects

- [Senderrr](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/Senderrr): a multi-tenant WhatsApp automation gateway with an atomic send-lock and Chrome DevTools-level interception of WhatsApp's own link-preview fetch, migrating from the cloud to a single Android phone.
- [tiffin](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/tiffin): replaces a school canteen's handwritten meal register — one scan per meal per day, grace credit for empty balances, UPI QR billing, running off a phone hotspot.
- [FastAPI Boilerplate](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/Fast-API-Boiler-Plate): a production foundation with dependency injection, the repository pattern across four databases, rotating JWTs, Redis sessions, rate limiting, and Sentry.
- [OptiFlow](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/OptiFlow): a clinic appointment system that runs through WhatsApp — books slots, estimates travel time, and counts people in the waiting room. (work in progress)
- [NebulaDB](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/NebulaDB): a document database written from scratch in Rust, with a custom storage engine. (work in progress)
- [JARVIS](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/JARVIS): an autonomous AI operating system that boots as PID 1, with 7 agents and a local-plus-cloud dual brain. (work in progress)
